               ORG     #7000
; ---------

duatr          EQU     #7000;ATTRIBUTES
border         EQU     #7001
winatr         EQU     #7002
butatr         EQU     #7004
nameatr        EQU     #7006
chbxatr        EQU     #7008
dwatr          EQU     #700a
koncol         EQU     #700c;KONSOL ATTR
track          EQU     #700e;EXTENDED DIRECTORY TRRRACK
ext            EQU     #7010;DB      "SCRRLECMP123123123123"
free           EQU     #7025;UNUSED
fils           EQU     #7027;FILES ON DISK
lstf           EQU     #7029;LAST FILE NUMBER
delf           EQU     #702a;DELETED FILES
flg            EQU     #702c
cords          EQU     #702d
xtxt           EQU     #702e
ytxt           EQU     #702f
xlen           EQU     #7030
ylen           EQU     #7031
fn             EQU     #7032
pnosn          EQU     #7033
flgs           EQU     #7034
filwin         EQU     #7036
cur            EQU     #7037
step           EQU     #7039;MOUSE STEP
restbl         EQU     #703a;RESIDENTS TABLE
               ORG     #7058
obois          DB      "FlyShit C",0
music          DB      "MUS     C",0
theme          DB      "THEME   C",0
plugin         DB      "PLUG1   o",0
csr            DB      "CURSOR  C",0
resid          DB      "CLOCK   C",0
ssaver         DB      "SAVER   C",0
setnm          DB      "fsetup  s",0
plugv          EQU     #70a8;PLUG VIEW (CALL WH. UNKN. EXT)
data           EQU     #70aa;DATA FOR NUMBER PRINT
mpl            EQU     #70b2;MUSIC PLAY ADDRES
stime          EQU     #70b4;SCREEN SAVER TIME ELAPSED
               ORG     #7100
setwin         EQU     #7100;SET WINDOW
checkw         EQU     #7103;CHECK WINDOW
animal         EQU     #7106;MOUSE
dopus          EQU     #7109
read           EQU     #710c;REREAD DISK CATALOG TO #C000
multy          EQU     #710f;HL=B*C
page           EQU     #7112;SET PAGE
cpblok         EQU     #7115;CP TWO BLOCK (HL&DE)
gtadr          EQU     #7118;GET ADDR OF FILE DESC (IN PAGE 0)
getext         EQU     #711b;GET ADDR OF EXTENDED FILE DESC
clearbf        EQU     #711e;CLEAR FILENAME BUFFER
viewf          EQU     #7121;VIEW FILE (FNM=NUMBER OF FILENAME)
xyatr          EQU     #7124;XY->ADDR IN ATR
xyscr          EQU     #7127;XY->ADDR IN SCR
prstr          EQU     #712a;Print String HL-ADDR,BC -COOR.
remw           EQU     #712d;REMOVE WINDOW FROM SCREEN
shutay         EQU     #7130;SHUT UP MUSIC COPROC
paused         EQU     #7133;PAUSE
press          EQU     #7136;PRESS ZNK IN SCR(BC - COORDINATES)
putspr         EQU     #7139;PUT SPRITE
prsum          EQU     #713c;SET NUMBER (IN HL) TO DATA STRING)
uph            EQU     #713f;UP H
downh          EQU     #7142;DOWN H
mnu            EQU     #7145;MAIN MENU
dos            EQU     #7148;TR DOS
getfil         EQU     #714b;FILE PANEL
ankey          EQU     #714e;WAIT ANY KEY
rpkey          EQU     #7151;WAIT UNTIL ANY KEY UNPRESSED
getarc         EQU     #7154;GET ARC ATR BYTE&ADDRES(BC-COORD)
mscrd          EQU     #7157;GET MOUSE COORDINATES (IN BC)
kilarc         EQU     #715a;KILL 'move window' ARCADE LINE
sssr           EQU     #715d;SAVE SCREEN IN PAGE 7
ussr           EQU     #7160;REPRINT SCREEN FROM PAGE 7
mst            EQU     #70b6;MOUSE MINIMAL STEP

               ORG     #6000
               LCODE   "DBG3_33"
;----------------------------------------------------
               ORG     #9c3c
               ENT
               JP      #7200
;----------------------------------------------------
               ORG     #9c40
;----------------------------------------------------
;Now following text of your programm

               ORG     #9c40
junk           PUSH    IX
               LD      IX,ju_win1
               LD      A,#16
               CALL    page
               CALL    setwin
               LD      A,#11
               CALL    jun1
               POP     IX
               RET
jun1           LD      A,#16
               CALL    page
               CALL    animal
               CALL    checkw
               JR      jun1
savef          PUSH    IX
               LD      IX,savewin
               LD      A,#16
               CALL    page
               CALL    setwin
               LD      A,#11
               CALL    juba_1
               POP     IX
               LD      A,#16
               CALL    page
               CALL    remw
               CALL    setwin
               RET
juba_1         LD      A,#16
               CALL    page
               CALL    animal
               CALL    checkw
               JR      juba_1
sv1st          LD      HL,#c000
               JR      savef_1
sv2nd          LD      HL,#db00
savef_1        PUSH    HL
               LD      HL,named
               LD      DE,#5cdd
               LD      BC,8
               LDIR
               POP     HL
               LD      A,#11
               CALL    page
               LD      DE,#1b00
               LD      C,11
               CALL    dos
               LD      C,10
               CALL    dos
               LD      A,"s"
               LD      (#5ce5),A
               LD      A,"c"
               LD      (#5ce6),A
               LD      A,"r"
               LD      (#5ce7),A
               LD      A,C
               LD      C,9
               CALL    dos
               LD      A,#16
               CALL    page
               RET
jun2           PUSH    IX
               LD      IX,oths
               LD      A,#16
               CALL    page
               CALL    setwin
               LD      A,#11
               CALL    jun_3
               POP     IX
               CALL    remw
               CALL    setwin
               RET
fuck           LD      A,#11
               CALL    page
               LD      DE,#c000
               LD      HL,0
               LD      BC,#1800
fu_1
               LD      A,(DE)
               AND     (HL)
               LD      (DE),A
               INC     DE
               DEC     BC
               INC     HL
               LD      A,B
               OR      C
               JR      NZ,fu_1
               RET

jun_3          LD      A,#16
               CALL    page
               CALL    animal
               CALL    checkw
               JR      jun_3
stf            LD      DE,#c000
               LD      HL,#db00
               CALL    eff
               CALL    v1
               RET
fts            LD      DE,#db00
               LD      HL,#c000
               CALL    eff
               CALL    v2
               RET
eff            LD      A,#11
               CALL    page
               LD      BC,0
               PUSH    BC
               LD      BC,#1800
loop
               POP     AF
               LD      A,(HL)
ll1            CPL;EDGE
ll2            RRA;SOFTEN
               PUSH    AF
ll3            OR      (HL);BACKSET
ll4            AND     (HL);ANDSET
ll5            CPL;OUT INVERT
               LD      (DE),A
               INC     HL
               INC     DE
               DEC     BC
               LD      A,B
               OR      C
               JR      NZ,loop
               POP     AF
               LD      BC,#300
               LDIR
               LD      A,#16
               CALL    page
atb            RET
maniac
               LD      HL,#4000
               LD      DE,#c000
               LD      BC,#1b00
               LDIR
               RET
savscr         LD      A,#17
               CALL    page
               LD      HL,#4000
               LD      DE,#e4ff
               LD      BC,#1b00
               LDIR
               RET
unscr          LD      A,#17
               CALL    page
               LD      HL,#e4ff
               LD      DE,#4000
               LD      BC,#1b00
               LDIR
               RET
unp_1          LD      HL,#c000
               LD      (un_1+1),HL
               LD      (un_2+1),HL
               JR      unpk
unp_2          LD      HL,#db00
               LD      (un_1+1),HL
               LD      (un_2+1),HL
unpk           LD      A,#17
               CALL    page
               CALL    maniac
               LD      A,#ff
               LD      (lstf),A
               LD      A,#11
               OR      8
               CALL    page
un_1           CALL    #c000
               LD      HL,#4000
un_2           LD      DE,#c000
               LD      BC,#1b00
               LDIR
               LD      A,#1f
               CALL    page
               LD      HL,#c000
               LD      DE,#4000
               LD      BC,#1b00
               LDIR
               LD      A,#11
               CALL    page
               RET
v1             LD      HL,#c000
               JR      views
v2             LD      HL,#db00
views          PUSH    HL
               CALL    savscr
               POP     HL
               LD      A,#11
               CALL    page
               LD      DE,#4000
               LD      BC,#1b00
               LDIR
               CALL    rpkey
               CALL    ankey
               CALL    unscr
               CALL    rpkey
               LD      A,#16
               CALL    page
               RET
amd            LD      A,(sx1)
               LD      (suxx),A
               JR      andbf
ormd           LD      A,(sx3)
               LD      (suxx),A
               JR      andbf
xormd          LD      A,(sx2)
               LD      (suxx),A
andbf          LD      A,#11
               CALL    page
               LD      BC,#1800
               LD      HL,#db00
               LD      DE,#c000
an_1           LD      A,(DE)
suxx           AND     (HL)
               LD      (DE),A
               INC     HL
               INC     DE
               DEC     BC
               LD      A,B
               OR      C
               JR      NZ,an_1
               CALL    v1
               LD      A,#16
               CALL    page
               RET
sx1            AND     (HL)
sx2            XOR     (HL)
sx3            OR      (HL)
ju_win1        DB      5,5,5,11
               DW      nm1a,v1,v2
               DB      16,1,1
               DW      tx_1
               DB      0,16,2,1
               DW      tx_2
               DB      0,16,3,1
               DW      tx_3
               DB      0,16,4,1
               DW      tx_4
               DB      0,16,5,1
               DW      tx_5
               DB      0,16,6,1
               DW      tx_6
               DB      0,16,7,1
               DW      tx_7
               DB      0,5,2,7
               DW      ll1
               DB      #2F,5,3,7
               DW      ll2
               DB      #1F,5,4,7
               DW      ll3
               DB      #B6,5,5,7
               DW      ll4
               DB      #A6,5,6,7
               DW      ll5
               DB      #2F,17,7,1
               DW      op_1
               DB      6,17,8,1
               DW      op_2
               DB      6,17,9,1
               DW      op_3
               DB      6,17,10,1
               DW      op_4
               DB      6,17,11,1
               DW      op_5
               DB      6,#FF
oths           DB      7,7,8,8
               DW      nm2a,v1,v2
               DB      17,1,1
               DW      op_6
               DB      8,17,2,1
               DW      op_7
               DB      8,17,3,1
               DW      op_8
               DB      8,17,4,1
               DW      op_9
               DB      8,17,5,1
               DW      op_10
               DB      8,17,6,1
               DW      op_11
               DB      8,17,7,1
               DW      op_12
               DB      8,17,8,1
               DW      op_13
               DB      8,#FF
savewin        DB      7,7,6,4
               DW      nm4a,v1,v2
               DB      19,2,2
               DW      named
               DB      10,17,3,1
               DW      op_14
               DB      7,17,4,1
               DW      op_15
               DB      7,#FF
named          DB      "XXXXYYYY",0
nm4a           DB      "SAVE...",0
op_14          DW      sv1st
               DB      "Save 1st buffer",0
op_15          DW      sv2nd
               DB      "Save 2nd buffer",0
nm1a           DB      "..Oops..",0
tx_1           DB      "EFFECTS SET:",0
tx_2           DB      "EDGE INVERT:",0
tx_3           DB      "SHIFT RIGHT:",0
tx_4           DB      "BACK SET:",0
tx_5           DB      "FILTER SET:",0
tx_6           DB      "OUT INVERT:",0
tx_7           DB      "+- OPTIONS: -+",0
op_1           DW      fts
               DB      "1 TO BUFFER 2",0
op_2           DW      stf
               DB      "2 TO BUFFER 1",0
op_3           DW      getfil
               DB      "FILE MENU",0
op_4           DW      savef
               DB      "SAVE MENU...",0
op_5           DW      jun2
               DB      "OTHERS...",0
nm2a           DB      "OTHERS...",0
op_6           DW      v1
               DB      "View 1st Buffer",0
op_7           DW      v2
               DB      "View 2nd Buffer",0
op_8           DW      unp_1
               DB      "Unpack 1st Buffer",0
op_9           DW      unp_2
               DB      "Unpack 2nd Buffer",0
op_10          DW      amd
               DB      "Buff 1 AND Buff 2",0
op_11          DW      ormd
               DB      "Buff 1 OR Buff 2",0
op_12          DW      xormd
               DB      "Buff 1 XOR Buff 2",0
op_13          DW      fuck
               DB      "Damage buffer 1...",0
